description:
The image is a false-colour infrared satellite or aerial photograph illustrating two different types of water courses and their surrounding land cover. In this representation, vegetated areas appear in magenta/red tones, while water bodies are depicted in dark blue/cyan.
A blue annotation box in the upper left, labeled "Highly modified water channel = 8.1.2 Highly modified water courses and canals," points via an arrow to the upper water body, which is a visibly straight, narrow, and clearly channelized feature.
A second blue annotation box in the lower right, labeled "Natural water course not modified = 8.1.1 Natural & semi-natural water courses," points with an arrow to the lower water body, which exhibits a wider, meandering path characteristic of a natural or semi-natural river. The image visually differentiates these two land cover classification categories within the context of Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines, particularly relevant to the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC).
